full_judgment: (Latin: “To say [what] the law [is].”) This is the traditional function of courts, and it is usually understood as a limitation upon their power (jus dicere, et non jus dare). “It is emphatically the province of the judicial department to say what the law is”- Chief Justice john marshall inmarbury v. madison (1803).
